content_sections.heading: About TMC-ACTREC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC is located at Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The notice is issued by an outsourced contractor for manpower services, A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., which is looking for an Audiologist to be placed on contract at the centre. The engagement is therefore through the contractor and not a direct post of the centre.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites candidates for one post, Audiologist, to be placed at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410 210. Essential qualification: Master of Audiology and Speech Language Pathology (MASLP) or equivalent. The candidate should have minimum one year of work experience after P.G. in a reputed institution, with special interest in audiology in oncology and developing audiological services. The notice also says the candidate should have interest in performing various audiological evaluations. These are: special tests to identify cochlear pathology / retro cochlear pathology pure tone audiometry speech audiometry advanced auditory evoked potential The candidate should also have knowledge in using patient reported outcomes in audiological care. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording. Up to 35 years (may be relaxed on experience basis). The notice prints no date for counting age and gives no category-wise relaxation. Duration of the engagement is 6 months (extendable as per requirement).

rows.pay: Consolidated salary ₹ 50,000/- to ₹ 60,000/- p.m., on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates should come to the interview along with: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph Scanned copies of Aadhar Card and PAN Card ORIGINAL and self attested copies of qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates

content_sections.text: The post is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., an outsourced contractor for manpower services.
